issue.body:
### What

`COM-API` is not enabled in this case due to `LoLa` does not support find service call with `ANY`, it require specific `InstanceSpecifier`.
Because of this `COM-API` is added `panic!`.

### How

Once `LoLa` adds the `ANY` support for find service call then we will add in rust library also.

### Estimates for realization

0

comments.body:
LoLa already supports any-semantics in the SD.
See https://github.com/eclipse-score/communication/blob/0216ff909d95711ae60da1150d91aa1715a8f2e5/score/mw/com/impl/bindings/lola/service_discovery/flag_file_crawler.cpp#L176

Yes in case of finding service instances using `InstanceIdentifier`, `FindService` with any-semantic is there but i think with `InstanceSpecifier` it is not there.

https://github.com/eclipse-score/communication/blob/main/score/mw/com/design/service_discovery/README.md?plain=1#L135C90-L135C108

With any-semantic support for `InstanceIdentifier` we can get list of instance of same service (`InstanceSpecifier`) . but the API which is rust the goal of that API all the available services on system should be return as a list.
